༄༅/ /gcod kyi gdams pa thugs kyi snying po'i lo rgyus bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gcod kyi gdams pa thugs kyi snying po'i

lo rgyus bzhugs so/ / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bka' shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gcod kyi gdams pa 'di la/ yid ches shing khung btsun par byed pa bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas/ thugs dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ bar du bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags/ tha ma mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul du sangs rgyas nas/ de'i 'bras bu chos kyi 'khor lo grangs med pa rnam pa gsum du bskor ba las/ 'di gnyis pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dgongs pa yin/ de la yang mngon par rtogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ snying po don gyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis las/ 'di snying po don gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin/ rab 'byor gyis zhus/ ston pas gsungs/ kun dga' bos bsdus/ byams pas lung bstan te/ slob dpon thog med la bshad/ des slob dpon dbyig gnyen la/ des slob dpon ār+ya de wa la/ des dam pa rin po che la bshad/ de la'ang dam pa'i lo rgyus ni/ khyad par drug dang ldan te/ skye ba bdun gyi che ba*/ skye sa yul gyi che ba/ byin rlabs thugs rje'i che ba/ sbyangs pa thugs rje yon tan gyi che ba/ 'bras bu dngos grub kyi che ba'o/ /de la dang po ni skye ba bdun du gzhan gyis bar ma chod par mi lus gtsang ma rigs bzhi thob/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'ba' zhig tu gyur/ skye ba 'dir rigs bzhi'i nang nas/ khyad par 'phags pa'i rigs bram zer skyes/ skye sa yul gyi che ba ni/ rgya gar gyi yul rtsa ri seng ha bya ba thugs rje chen po'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas der sku 'khrungs te/ yab bram ze brtson 'grus go cha/ yum bram ze mo sa ra ha pa bya ba la bu gsum yod pa'i bar pa yin/ bslab pa tshul khrims kyi che ba ni/ lo bcu gsum la dpal bī kra ma la shi la'i gtsug lag khang du/

rab tu byung nas dge tshul mdzad/ bla ma gser gling pa la byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa bsrungs/ rnal 'byor pho mo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi la dbang zhus nas sngags kyi dam tshig bsrungs ba'o/ /byin rlabs thugs rje'i che ba ni/ rnal 'byor pho mo lnga bcu rtsa bzhis rjes su bzung nas dbang gdams pa dang bcas pa gnang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthu dang nus pa dpag tu med pa dang ldan zhing*/ yi dam dang ṭāk+ki ma dang bcas pa dpag tu med pas dbang dang byin rlab kyi bka' babs du ma dang ldan pas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub la mnga' brnyes pa'o/ /sbyangs pa yon tan gyi che ba ni/ lo lnga nas 'bri klog bslabs pas legs par mkhyen/ phyi mtshan nyid kyi sde snod/ nang gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde ma lus pa mkhyen cing*/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po yin no/ /'bras bu dngos grub kyi che ba ni/ thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob/ mchog gi dngos grub phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa khyad par can mngon du gyur pa'o/ /de lta bu'i bla ma des/ 'gro ba'i don du bod du lan mang du byon pa las/ lan gcig dus su/ slo dpon rgya gar nas bod la tshur byon dus/ dge bshes dngos grub snying po zhes bya ba/ g.yor po gra thang nas yin pa zhig /rgya gar du phyin nas lo tsā ba'i chos slob du phyin pa yin zer ba'i chu shing gi 'khar ba la/ sems can gyi gzugs sna tshogs bkod pa thogs pa zhig dang*/ bla ma sma ra ser po can bya ba/ bod kyi chos pa la yid ma ches par/ rgya gar du gdams pa 'tshol du phyin pas ma rnyed pa tshur log ste/ bal yul du bla ma ma hā mu lar phag mo zhu ru 'gro ba dang*/ tshong pa mang po bsdebs nas byung ste/ bal yul du zla ba tsam 'gor/ de nas bod du rje dam pa sangs rgyas dang bsdebs nas 'ongs/ der khong gnyis kyis bsam pa la/ a tsa ra 'di grub thob zhig yin par 'dug ste/

mu stegs pa dang*/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa gang yin ma shes pas/ gdams pa ni ma zhus/ de nas mang yul du slebs pa dang*/ a tsa ra'i tshong brdal gnyis 'dug pas/ de kun a tsa ra de la mos gus drag po byed/ me tog mang po 'bul gyin 'dug pas/ bla ma ji skad bya ba yin dris pas/ 'di rgya gar na bla ma paṇ+ḍi ta ka ma la shi la zer/ bod na dam pa rgya gar ba bya ba grags/ paṇ+ḍi ta grub thob mkhas pa chen po zhig yin/ sngar yang bod du mang du byon/ da res kyang bod du byon par 'dug zer bas/ der khong rnams kyis byin rlabs shig zhu byas pas/ dge bshes la 'khar ba de thong 'di 'dra ma 'dzin sems bskyed 'chor ba'i rgyu yin/ ngas kyang shes te ma byas/ sems can bslus na dgos pa med/ skyur la thongs gsungs so/ /gdams pa zhig zhu byas pas/ khyed rang phyi'i snang ba nang du ma len/ nang gi rig pa phyir ma spro/ sems lus la ma chags par lus sems phrol la zhog /gsungs pas/ de la nges shes su chos 'tshol du phyin pas ma rnyed par/ bod du log pas bla ma grub thob dang mjal 'dug snyam nas/ bla ma gang du gshegs pa'i phyag phyir 'brangs te/ gdams pa zhig thob par bya dgos dgongs nas/ phyag phyi la song*/ de nas lab rtag ri bya bar slebs nas/ mgron khang zhig na bzhugs te/ byin rlabs zhu bar mang po byung ba la/ mig long pa phyed pa dang*/ rna ba 'on pas sgra thos pa la sogs byung bas/ thams cad ngo mtshar skyes so/ /yul der dge bshes skyo shākya ye shes zhes bya ba/ mdo sgyu 'phrul gyi mkhan po zhig gdan drangs nas/ chos gsung gin bzhugs pa'i phyag phyi la/ myang stod grags chen grags chung bya ba/ pha mes sngags pa mthu chen la 'gras nas/ mdze byung dogs pa'i byis pa gnyis/ pha mdze pho zhig gis 'bum bcu gsum dum pa zhig dang dngos po mang po dang bcas pa phul/ byis pa gnyis kyi gnyer gtad nas yod pa la/ dge bshes sku bsod che bas g.yeng bas khyer te/

byis pa de gnyis la nya ra ma byung sman ma byin/ gdon gyis zin pa'i rtags mang po byung yang*/ dge bshes thugs khral du song yod pa la/ mgron khang nang du a tsa ra byin rlabs can zhig 'dug zer ba thos nas/ der phyin nas zhus pa/ spyir khyed rgya gar ba rig pa'i 'byung gnas yin pa dang*/ khyad par du bla ma khyed byin rlabs can zhig 'dug zer ba thos pas/ bdag la byin pa lha 'dre'i za 'phro gnyis yod pas/ de la byin rlabs thugs la 'dogs par zhu byas pas/ de tsug bya yi gsungs nas/ de'i dus su bla ma sma ra ser po can la/ da ni khyod 'dod pa'i gdams pa zhig 'ong ba gda' 'o gsungs/ der bsnyen bkur byas nas gdams pa zhus pas/ byis pa gnyis/ bla ma sma ra can/ dge bshes skyo dang bzhi la gdams pa btabs te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ sgyu 'phrul dum tshogs drug /ngo sprod zhal gdams dang bcas pa gnang ste/ de nyid du gdams ngag btab/ byis pa gnyis kyis nyams len byas pas grub thob bzang po re byung ngo*/ /de nas bla ma sma ra ser po can pha yul du byon nas/ gcod 'di dang bal po ha lu ma la zhus pa'i jo mo zhal chung ma tshang bar nyams su blangs nas sgrub pa la brtson par mdzad do/ /gdams pa gzhan la ma byin/ 'grongs khar khong rang gi nye gnas smyon pa 'ba' re la gnang ngo*/ /skyo shākya ye shes kyis kho bo rang gi dbon bsod nams bla ma la gnang*/ des ma gcig lab kyi sgron ma la gnang*/ de yang ma cig 'di ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i sprul pa yin par mdo las gsal zhing*/ khyad par du slob dpon pad+mas lung bstan pa'o/ /de'i lo rgyus ni/ slob dpon pad+ma la/ dbang rin chen kha ches zhus pa/ e ma slob dpon chen po lags/ /ma gcig jo mo mtsho rgyal 'di/ /gang dang gang gi sprul pa yin/ /don chen gang la dgongs te byon/ /'das grong mnga' 'am rnam pa gang*/ /zhes zhus pas/ o rgyan gu rus bka' stsal pa/

mtsho rgyal ma gcig 'dug pa de/ /dang po sgron ma'i sprul pa yin/ /dgos ched nga yi gsang sngags 'dzin/ /phyi rabs las can kun gyi ma/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar byed/ / 'das grong mi mnga'i rnal 'byor ma/ /nga dang skad cig 'bral med ma/ /rnam thar legs pa'i cha lugs kyis/ /zag med bde ba ster byed ma/ /ma gcig 'dug pa'i mtsho rgyal 'di/ /rang bzhin gnas las ma g.yos shing*/ /lo ni drug cu kha ral tshe/ /lab kyi sgron ma bya ba sprul/ /phar phyin snying po'i don grol nas/ /sems can chos kyi dbyings su 'god/ /sna tshogs nges med spyod pa byed/ /mtsho rgyal ma gcig sprul pa zhes/ /lung bstan pa de yang*/ bod yul dbus kyi sa cha/ g.yo ru yam shod smad/ e che mo lab ces bya bar sku 'khrungs te/ yab chos la skyabs/ yum klu mo bza' 'bum lcam/ ming bo 'khor lo/ /ma gcig 'di chung shos yin/ dang po yum gyi lhums su zhugs dus/ yum gyi lus yang zhing bde ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin rang shugs skye ba dang*/ dngos sam nyams snang la zhag grangs mang por lung pa thams cad pad+ma kha phye ba bzhin/ 'od kyis nyin mtshan med par khengs pa dang*/ yum gyi rmi lam du nam mkha' gos su gyon pa/ sa gzhi gdan du bting ba/ spyi bo na rin po che 'dug pa/ smin mtshams nas 'od kha dog rnam pa lnga shar ba rmis so/ /sku 'khrungs khar yang yab yum gyi mnal lam du/ rin po che zhig skyes te/ de la rin po che mang po 'phel nas/ sems can gyi 'dod pa tshims pa dang*/ 'khrungs pa zhig tu'ang*/ sgra dang 'od dang*/ sa g.yo ba la sogs pa bkra shis pa'i mtshan ma mang po byung ngo*/ /yab yum gnyis la ting nge 'dzin rang bzhin gyis skye ba dang*/ 'khrul pa'i snang ba gtad med du yal ba byung ngo*/ /de nas btsas pa'i tshe/ kun gyi yid du 'ong ba/ gzi brjid dang ldan par 'dug pas/ yum gyis mtshan me tog sgron du btags/ yab kyis skyid dge btags so/

/lo bdun brgyad lon dus/ slob dpon rgyal 'byung la yi ge slob du btang bas/ ngo sprad pa tsam gyis shes shing*/ pha rol tu phyin pa klog pa tsam gyis dgongs pa thugs su chud kyang gzhan gyis blor ma shong bas tha mal gyi tshul du bzhugs/ yab yum gyis ra lug 'tshor bcug pas/ rde'u mang po bsags nas grangs dang rtse mo byed kyin 'dug pas/ grong pa rnams na re/ khyed kyi bu mo 'dis lug rdzi mi yong*/ mo rang rde'u la rtse mo byed/ ra lug yan du 'jug par gda' zer bas/ yab kyis bltar phyin pas/ mo rde'u la rtse yin 'dug pas/ khyod rtse mo byed par 'dug /ra lug stor 'gro byas pas/ bor nas mi 'gro /mkha' 'gro mas nya ra byed pas/ tshang yong gsung ngo*/ /rde'u 'di tshos ci byed byas pas/ chos kyi 'gres rkang 'dren pa yin zer/ khyod kyis chos shes sam byas pas/ shes zer/ chos ji ltar shes/ khyod kyi chos de chos log ma yin nam byas pas chos log min/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' dgongs pa thams cad gcig tu 'dus par shes/ de yang sde snod gsum sems su 'dus/ sems sgyu ma lta bur shes/ sgyu ma lta bu de/ gzung ba dang bral bar rtogs zer/ 'o na de ngo shes gang la 'dzin byas pas/ bar snang gi nam mkha' la ltos dang*/ skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral bar 'dug pas/ der ngos 'dzin gsung*/ 'o na ngo mtshar che/ khyod skal ldan du 'dug pas/ ngas sdig pa bsags 'dug /da ra lug ma 'tsho zer nas/ bu mo gnyis po/ lhung dkar po'i slob dpon rgyal 'byung zhes pa'i drung du/ chos sgor bcug ste/ ma gcig gi mtshan dad pa'i sgron mar btags/ a cer dad pa'i lha mo btags/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum blo la 'chad pa byung*/ g.ya'i spyan gzugs kyi ltad mo la phyin pas/ bkrag dang skye gzugs legs pa'i thag chod/ khrom thams cad kyis 'di lha mo bas legs par 'dug zer bas/ lab kyi sgron ma btags so/ /gtsang du rdzogs chen dang sgyu 'phrul dang*/

byams chos 'grel chung la mkhas par bslabs/ rgyud sde kun gyi dgongs pa la mkhas par mkhyen par mdzad/ de nas skabs shig tu/ yon bdag gcig gi klog 'don mdzad pa'i dus su/ dbye rong nas dge bshes thod pa 'ba' re bya ba/ mi rabs bco brgyad du/ dge bshes kyi brgyud pa ma chad pa'i sras/ thod pa 'ba' re bya ba spyan drangs nas/ rim gro zhus pas/ khong yang gtor ma bshams nas/ gyer chog mi byed par bzhugs 'dug la/ yon bdag na re/ phrin las mi mdzad pa ci lags zhus pas/ do nub gtad med du shes pa dga' ba zhig byung*/ byed snying mi 'dod gsungs/ yon bdag pho mo tsho la'ang*/ blo bde gsal byas nas/ ci yang byed snying mi 'dod pa 'di yin 'di min gyi dran pa stor gyis 'gro ba zhig 'dug /mi rung ba yin nam byas pas/ dge bshes na re mi rung ba min/ mchod gnas ma 'di rigs ldan gcig tu 'dug /'di'i byin rlabs bkra shis par 'ongs gsungs/ der dge bshes kyis ma gcig mtshan ldan mar gzigs nas/ yab yum la bu mo bslangs pas/ yab na re 'di bu mo phal pa ma yin/ mi ster rang gi mchod gnas byed pa yin zer/ ma na re/ bud med kyi chos 'go thon pa 'ang dka' bas/ dge bshes yon tan rigs rgyud dang ldan pa 'di la sbyin pa drag zer nas/ dge bshes kyi jo mo la byin no/ /de nas dge bshes kyis jo mo sngon ma bzhag nas/ ma gcig dang sdebs nas/ kong po la rnyed pa 'tshol du phyin pas/ lo lnga na/ rta bcu gnyis tsam dang bcas pa rnyed do/ /sras mo zhig kong por 'khrungs pa las/ ming rga lcam du btags/ gcig lam bar du 'khrungs pas lam lcam du btags/ de nas gang so gcig mor bzhugs pa'i dus su/ sras gcig 'khrungs pas/ snying po'i don grub pa zhig 'ong gsungs nas/ snying po'i don grub btags so/ /de'i rting la sras gnyis 'khrungs par 'dug pas nga gru gnyis te/ sras gsum du 'khrungs/ de nas bza' mi tsho dbyes te chos mdzad do/

/ma cig gi zhal nas/ yab sras kun la thams cad chos byed dgos pa yin/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba gang la'ang snying po med/ nga yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don ston pa la mkhas pa zhig gi rtsar 'gro gsungs pas/ gral mo chog dkar rgyan bya ba na re/ gra thang skya mo na/ dge bshes gra pa mngon shes bya ba mkhas pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i nyan bshad sgom gsum byed pa zhig yod par 'dug zer bas/ der ma jo g.yag mo bya ba 'bri klog shes pa zhig khrid/ gser srang bcu gnyis khyer te/ bros nas byon pas dge bshes phar phyin gsungs pa dang 'dzoms te/ phyag rten phul nas gsan pa mdzad/ dge bshes gra pa'i zhal nas/ khyod chos gsan pa la rab tu byung na 'thad gsungs pas/ sngar yang chos sgor zhugs pa'i rgyu mtshan rnams zhus te/ 'on kyang bstan pa la dgongs nas/ chos sgor zhugs nas mtshan tshul khrims rgyan du btags so/ /lo bdun du nyi khri le brgyad ma/ lcags gzer can/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ mngon rtogs rgyan yi ge gcig ma yan chad phar phyin mang du gsan te mkhan pos thos bsam klog 'don de tsam yin/ da ji ltar du dgongs gsungs pas/ ma gcig gi zhal nas/ chos thams cad sems su rtogs la sems la bltas pas/ snang ba sna tshogs su shar ba thams cad/ ngo sprod sna tshogs sam 'ba' zhig tu go zhing*/ phyin ci ma log pa'i nges shes skyes/ chos dris tshad kyi lan don thog nas thebs par gda' gsungs/ 'o de rtogs pa nang nas shar ba bya ba yin/ gzhan ga la song*/ sems can la phan 'dogs pa la dbang gis chos kyi sgo 'byed dgos pas/ dbang re zhus shig gsungs/ de dus don dbang zhig gnang bar zhu zhes jo mos zhus pas/ khyod la dbang bskur ba'i slob dpon de nga min/ gtsang na zur gyi ka ba bzhi bya ba na/ skyo ston rnam gnyis bya ba yod/ der byon nas zhus gsungs/ der ma cig gis gser lhag ma rnams khyer nas/ gtsang phyogs su byon te/

skyo shākya ye shes dang mjal/ gser srang gsum phul nas/ dbang bskur zhig thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhus pas/ ngas do nub lha la 'dri gsungs/ nang par snga bar gser khyer nas byon te/ ṭāk+ki ma su kha sid+dhis dam pa byin gyis brlabs/ des bdag byin gyis brlabs/ ngas slob dpon bsod nams bla ma byin gyis brlabs pa yin/ 'di chig brgyud yin pas khyod dge bshes bsod nams bla mas byin gyis rlobs par 'dug /der byon nas zhus gsungs nas gser gtad do/ khong gang na bzhugs zhus pas khams sum pa gser shod du slob ma zhig gis gser 'bum bzhengs pa'i rab gnas la gdan drangs nas de na yod gsungs/ der byon pas ja yul du skor ba byed pa dang mjal/ der gser phul nas sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams zhus pas/ ngas do nub lha la 'dri'o gsungs/ nang par byon pas dbang bskur ba'i dus la bab par 'dug /nga khams nas yar slebs nas/ sang phod gang bar ngos la shog cig /de'i bar du gsol ba drag tu thobs shigs gsungs/ ma cig gis zhus pa/ chos zab la bar chad 'ongs bas/ bar chad mi 'ong pa zhig zhu zhus pas/ 'o na de ltar bya'o gsungs nas/ 'jug pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ gsol ba gdab pa/ byin rlabs lus sems 'brel pa'i gdams ngag phog /sgom pa yid la mi byed par ngo sprad/ lta ba bdud kyi gcod yul mi 'gyur ba bstan te/ nyams len de la gyis gsungs/ der bla ma khams su byon/ ma gcig tshur byon zangs ri rtags ldan na/ klog 'don byed kyin yod na/ sang phod bla ma khams nas 'ol khar byon te/ zangs rir phyag phebs pa dang*/ ma gcig gis mjal bas/ jo mos mi zas zos nas rang sdig ma bsags sam gsungs/ ngas jo ston mkhan po grags pa'i drung du/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos mang du zhus/ da lta klog 'don kun yang lta rtog gi tshul du 'don pa lags zhus pas/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum yod pa yin shod dang gsungs/

gzhi lam gnyis bshad nas/ don shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rtsal dbang khyed la zhu ba yin zhus pas/ der pha rgyud kyi gdams pa ngo sprod dang bcas pa gdan thog gcig tu rdzogs par gsungs pas/ dgongs pa gcig tu khrol log ge byung bas/ bla ma shin tu mnyes te/ snying po'i don ma lus pa gsungs/ de nas yar lam gang bar lha khang rnying par zhong ston 'ongs la/ klog skya lhas skyabs/ bya khrom pa/ 'dzi lhas pa rnams kyi zhu ba phul nas/ dbang zhus dus/ der byon pa dang dbang bskur ba'i dus la babs so gsungs/ thog mar gcod dbang sems la bskur/ de nas sgyu 'phrul gyi dbang mo che mdzad pa'i sta gon gyi dus su/ ma cig la byin phebs shing lus khru gang gis sa la mi reg par zhi ba'i gar sna nyi shu rtsa gsum mdzad/ gsung sang kri ta'i skad du smra/ thugs thogs pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma phye/ sku gcer bur byas te/ khang pa'i rtsig pa la thogs pa med par byon nas lha khang rgyab na sdong po gser lhag can bya ba klu drag po lag skyong bya ba gnas pa'i sar bzhugs so/ /de'i dus su dag pa'i snang ba mang po byung ste/ mkha' 'gro mas tshogs 'khor drangs pa dang*/ chos gsungs shing lung bstan pa mang po yod do/ / sang bla ma'i drung du byon tsa na/ mched grogs rnams na re/ de dbang bskur la mi bzhugs par/ dbang zab mo de ma thob zer/ ma gcig gi zhal nas/ 'dus byas rdzas kyi dbang de khyed rnams kyis thob/ chos nyid don gyi dbang ngas thob gsungs/ der bla mas ma gcig la ce re gzigs nas/ zhal 'dzum pa mdzad nas/ khyed rnams de skad ma zer cig /spyir dbang ma bskur yang thob bskur kyang thob pa dang*/ bskur na thob ma bskur na mi thob pa dang*/ bskur yang mi thob ma bskur yang mi thob pa las/ 'dir ma bskur yang thob pa 'di dgod bro/ khyed tshos thob pa'i dbang chu thigs pa re tsam yin/ 'di la rig pa rtsal gyi dbang thob bum pa gang 'jo bya ba yin gsungs/

bla ma'i zhal nas ma gcig la khyed la ji lta bu byung gsungs pas/ ma cig gi zhal nas/ sdong po gser klag tu bsdad tsa na/ skad cig ma cig la dpal o rgyan du phyin nas/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis tshogs 'khor rgya chen po bskor/ ye shes kyi ṭāk+ki ma rnams kyis chos mang du gsungs/ da lta yang blo la 'dug /rje btsun ma sgrol ma dang mjal te/ zhal nas rnal 'byor ma khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don de'i steng nas/ spyod pa rkyen ngan la thog rdzis gyis la gnyan sa brgya rtsa brgyad du 'grims la/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob par 'gyur/ khyod kyi rjes su zhugs pa'ang mang du grol bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /ṭāk+ki mas gsungs pa'i chos ji skad bya ba yod gsungs pas/ ma cig la mkha' 'gros gsungs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ltar yin zhes bla ma la zhus pas/ lta ba nam mkha' spros bral/ sgom pa sems nyid dri med/ spyod pa seng ge rtsal rdzogs/ 'bras bu nyi ma mun sel/ man ngag tshe lo nyi shu rtsa gcig dang bcas pa yod byas pas/ bla ma shin tu mnyes par gyur to/ /mched grogs rnams kyis dbang ji ltar thob zer ba la/ ma cig gi zhal nas/ ngas dbang bzhi skad cig ma la thob zer te/ phyi bum pa'i dbang lus la bde ba/ bskyed rim ma bsgom yang gzugs rang snang du grol nas yi dam dang ṭāk+ki mas byin gyis brlabs par gda'/ nang gsang ba'i dbang ngag la nus pa thob/ sgra grag stong du shes pas/ bsnyen sgrub sgra grag sngags su dag pas ma bzlas kyang*/ lha 'dre rang bzhin gyis chun par gda'o/ /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang sems la bde ba rang byung du skyes/ rtsa rlung 'grems pa spro bsdu thebs/ kha sbyor ma bsten kyang bde stong rgyun chad mi gda'o/ /de kho na nyid tshig dbang rin po che/ lde mig gi dbang thob pas/ chos nyid spros bral gyi don rtogs/ bde gsal mi rtog pa rang byung du shar/

thun mong gi dngos grub rang byung du shugs las 'byung*/ chos dris tshad kyi lan don thog shas cher thebs par gda' gsungs/ de nas bla ma'i gsungs nas/ khyed ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i rigs yin/ dbang rab thod rgal rtogs grol dus mnyam yin/ zhal mjal gsung thos kyang ngan song du mi 'gro bas/ gsang spyod du ma zhugs par 'gro don mdzod/ sbas nas sdod pa phangs gsungs nas/ rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ rgya mtsho klong la sogs pa rnams mdzub khrid du gsungs/ de ltar na rgyud sde gsang sngags rnams la dgongs pa phyogs med du grol te/ byin rlabs kyi drod kyis phan pa phyogs med du rgyas nas byung bas/ 'ga' zhig na re/ 'di la nus pa 'di tsam 'ong ba/ mu stegs kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i rigs min nam zer ba la/ ma jo g.yag mos bla ma la bsten lugs dang*/ lung bstan lugs rnams bshad pas yid ches par gyur to/ / de nas ma cig gnyan khrod du byon nas/ spyod pa nges med kyi tshul du bzhugs kyin yod pa'i dus/ ma cig gra thang na bzhugs pa'i skabs shig na/ dam pa rin po che 'phan yul nyi khung dgon pa na bzhugs pa'i dus/ zhing skyong gi ṭāk+ki ma mang po byon nas/ yum chen mo'i sprul pa shar phyogs kyi mkha' 'gro ma des/ mu stegs kyi mkha' 'gro ma thams cad brtul nas/ da lta bod na ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas/ mu stegs kyi mkha' 'gro ma bzhi 'dul zhing*/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i don rgyas par ston pa'i phyir/ lab kyi sgron ma zhes bya bar skye ba bzhes nas da lta gra thang na yod de la btud cing rjes su yi rang phul la/ phyi rabs kyi las can rnams kyi don du/ phar phyin don gyi bka' dang*/ gdams ngag ma lus par ston cig dang*/ snyigs ma'i sems can sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba rnams smin cing grol bar byed do zhes lung bstan byas nas/ dam pa rin po che gra thang du byon pa dang*/

ma cig gnas la skor ba byed pa dang*/ mjal nas bstod pa mdzad pa/ shes rab lnga dang ldan pa yi/ /yum chen mkha' 'gro'i sprul pa khyed/ /rnam thar gsum gyi sgo phye la/ /bdud kyi dpung 'joms mdzad pa yi/ /lab kyi sgron ma khyod la bstod/ /bdag da ltar khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod kyi sgom dang nyams myong gis/ /snyigs ma'i 'gro rnams smin grol byed/ /phyi rabs don du gdams ngag bshad/ gsungs nas/ chos dbang sems la bskur ba dang*/ phar phyin don gyi gzhung gdams pa drod tshad zhal shes dang bcas pa thams cad gnang ngo*/ khyod la chos bshad mi dgos/ nga dang khyod la dbyer med/ chu la chu bzhag 'dra/ khyod rang gi don rtogs pa de la nan tan mdzod/ the tshom za ba 'ga' re 'dug na de rnams la gzhan don gyi gdams ngag 'di ltar du thobs shig /de yang mtho ris lha mi'i lam/ nges 'byung dgra bcom pa la sogs pa'i lam gnyis yin no/ /gsungs so/ /de'i don lnga pa gcig zhu lags zhus pas/ lha mi'i lam skyabs 'gro sems bskyed mi dge ba bcu spong ba/ dge ba bcu dang du len pa yin/ byang chub kyi lam la byin rlabs nam mkha' sgo 'byed/ sgom pa 'dzin med blo bral/ lta ba spros med bdud kyis ma khyer ba dag yin mod gsungs/ chos 'di yi brgyud pa gang yin zhus pas/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ des 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge /des ṭāk+ki ma su kha sid+dhi/ des bdag la/ ngas skyo shākya ye shes/ skyo ston bsod nams bla ma/ des khyod rang la bsten pa de yin mod gsungs/ gzhan yang kha 'thor gyi skor dang*/ zhi byed rten 'brel ma la sogs pa zhus so/ /de rnams bshad pa tshig gi brgyud pa yin/ byin rlabs thugs rje'i brgyud pa ni/ yum chen mo/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ des mkha' 'gro ma bde ba'i dngos grub/ des dam pa rin po che/ bsdu na rtogs pa ye shes kyi brgyud pa ni/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dngos la/

ma gcig gis gsan te/ mdo rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum la kha ton bgyis dang gdams pa zhig nang nas 'char gsungs/ de lta bu'i bka' byin rlabs dang ldan pa'i ma cig de/ rtsod pa thams cad dang bral zhing*/ mdo bstan bcos dang*/ grub thob du mas lung bstan cing*/ khyad par mdo dwangs snyigs 'byed pa'i le'u brgyad cu gsum pa las/ nga'i bstan pa snyigs ma'i rtsod pa rgyas ba'i dus/ /byang phyogs kha ba can ljongs su/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma yi/ /sprul pa lab sgron zhes bya 'byung*/ /zhes so/ /yang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud rgyas pa las/ nga yi bstan pa snyigs ma la/ /byang phyogs lab kyi grong khyer du/ /rgyal ba'i yum gyi sprul pa ni/ /sgron ma'i ming can 'byung bar 'gyur/ /skye med snying po'i don ston cing*/ /grong dang grong khyer ri sul dang*/ /dur khrod bas mtha' khyab par nyul/ /de yi chos ni dar bar byed/ /ces so/ /dam pa'i zhal nas/ bod na ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma yin pa/ cha lugs bud med du bzhugs pa bzhi 'dug /gang lags zhus pas/ lab stod kyi ma cig zha ma/ sna nams kyi shes pa sgron me/ 'bri mtshams kyi zhang lcam 'gro chung*/ zangs ri'i ma gcig lab sgron/ khong bzhi po mon dang dpa' gro'i sa mtshams su/ rdo gur bya ba'i brag phug yod par tshogs nas/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing 'dus pa'o/ /de yang ma cig zha ma de bde mchog gi grub thob yin/ shes pa sgron me de ku ru ku la'i grub thob yin/ phyag rgya chen pos rgyud grol ba yin/ zhang lcam 'gro chung de yang dag gi grub thob yin/ rdzogs chen gyis rgyud grol ba yin/ ma cig lab kyi sgron ma khros ma nag mo'i grub thob yin/ gcod kyis rgyud grol ba yin/ de rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa ni/ ma cig lab sgron yin te/ ma cig gnyan khrod du mar byon te/ spyod pa mtha' bton nas/ lha klu kun kyang bka' la nyan cing*/

dam las mi 'da'/ klu lag skyong dang*/ ma dros pa dus bzang la chos nyan du 'ongs/ yar lha sham po/ bal yul gangs ri'i jo bo rje chen po/ 'o de gung rgyal la sogs lha 'dre thams cad kyis srog sngags phul/ chos la spyod nas bran bzhin du nyan no/ /yar lha sham po/ rgyal po sde bzhi la sogs pa 'jig rten pa dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i khro bo dpag tu med pa la/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang po byung zhing*/ gzhan yang mngon shes dang*/ rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan nas/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir rtsod pa dang bral ba'i ma cig de la/ gtso che ba'i man ngag mang du yod kyang*/ sku gsum grol ba'i lam mchog tu gyur pa 'di la/ brgyud pa mang du gyes te/ thar pa'i lam srol du ma zhig 'dzugs pa lags shing*/ de yang bka' ma dang*/ gter ma dang*/ thugs brgyud la sogs zung bzhi ya brgyad do/ /spyir ma gcig la bu slob mang po yod kyang*/ brgyud 'dzin gyi sras bcu drug tu grags so/ /de la sras po bzhi sras mo bzhi/ rang dang mnyam pa'i sras brgyad do/ /sras po bzhi ni/ 'khrungs pa'i sras rgyal ba don grub/ brgyud 'dzin gyi sras rtogs ldan ngag gi dbang phyug /thugs zin gyi sras grol ti rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ skal ldan gyi sras sgom chos seng ge /rang dang 'dra ba'i slob ma rgyan bzhi bya ba ni/ lab lung gi 'bro bza' rgyan/ gangs dkar lce rang gi zhang lcam dpal rgyan/ gnon tshe'i lto cha 'bum rgyan/ 'phan yul gyi nyang mo bsod nams rgyan no/ /rang dang mnyam pa'i sras brgyad ni/ mkhyen pa rang dang mnyam pa dwags po rong kha'i skye med dga' yan/ rtogs pa rang dang mnyam pa lho brag gtam shul gyi zhig po hur thon/ thugs rje rang dang mnyam pa 'phan yul gyi skal ldan seng ge /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul rang dang mnyam pa mal gro la yi rgyal sgo hag thon/ 'gro don rang dang mnyam pa gong po'i rje btsun zil gnon dang brgyad du byung ngo*/

de la sras don grub nas brgyud pa tsho dbus na dar cha che/ stong sde'i brgyud pa lho brag na dar cha che/ khu sgom nas brgyud pa gtsang na dar cha che/ rang dang mnyam pa'i sras brgyad nas brgyud pa rnams gnyal lo rong sogs phyogs mtha' dag na col le khyab bo/ /sras mo rgyan bzhi'i skor la sogs pa tsho la/ byin rlabs kyi bka' babs te/ mdo rgyud gter ma'i skor du grags te/ khams na dar cha che/ 'di dag gi brgyud pa ni yum chen mo/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa/ 'jam dpal/ sgrol ma/ su kha sid+dhi/ ār+ya de wa/ dam pa sangs rgyas/ ma cig lab sgron/ khu sgom chos seng*/ lo ras 'jam dbyangs mgon po/ dngos grub a seng*/ sangs rgyas seng sman lung pa/ dpal ldan rin chen/ ḍa me shi la/ des bdag la'o/ /de la sras rnams kyi nang nas stong sde dang*/ grol sde gnyis dang 'jam dpal nas gsungs tshad yi ge la ma thebs so/ khong rnam gnyis kyis ma cig la zhus pas/ gdung 'dzin gyi sras gang tsam yod ces zhus pas/ snying po'i don ma nor bar spyod cing*/ 'gro ba 'dren pa mang rab 'ong bar gda'/ de kun kho mo'i brgyud 'dzin yin/ bus kyang gdung 'dzin te mchis gsungs/ de nas bu'ang sngar la a ra byed dus/ ban sngags mthu can dang 'gras te/ phyis 'gyod de dbang med sngon gyi las 'phro yi skabs phye nas/ ma cig drung du chos sgor zhugs nas/ ming rgyal ba don grub tu btags/ chos khrid tshar nas dpe 'bri bar zhu byas pas/ khyod kyang chos sgor zhugs pa de cung 'phyis/ 'phral blo la shar nas bris tshad tho phyir du byung gis khyer yongs/ da mos gus dang nyams len la rags las pa yin/ khyed rang mos gus gyis gsol ba thob dang*/ dpe nang nas 'char ba'i rig pa gsal zhing rtogs pa yon tan gyi rtsal skyed pa byed do gsungs so/ /gzhan yang bu chen rnams kyi thugs kyi nying khu/ zhal gyi bdud rtsi/ yi ger thebs pa mang zhing sku gshegs khar yang*/

sngar gyi gnang ba tsho gnad kyi snying po 'ba' zhig tu 'dug na'ang/ da nyams len thugs kyi snying po zhig zhu byas pas/ ngas shes tshad bu des shes yod/ kho la zhus gsungs pas/ ma cig rang gi zhal nas gsungs pa'i gdams ngag cig zhu byas pas/ zhal gdams bdud rtsi'i snying gtam nyams kyi thigs pa/ dgos don bcud kyi snying po la sogs pa gnang nas/ de'i tshe thog mtshams ya gir shog dril gcig yod kyi/ de longs la khyed kyi sems kyi me long gyis/ sems rten de la yong bar yod gsungs/ sras dang bu slob rnams kyis mngon sum dang*/ nyams snang rmi lam du sprul pa dpag tu med pa mthong*/ la las yum chen mo/ la las sgrol ma/ la las mkha' 'gro ma mang po'i dbus na 'dug pa mthong*/ la las rdo rje phag mor mthong ba la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab/ yang lan gcig sras kyi rjes su 'brang nas phyin pas/ ne'u gsing sngon po zhig gi thog na brag dang shug pa yod pa/ chu mig dkar po lhog lhog pa zhig gi 'gram na/ rde'u sngo khrom yod pa gcig tu ma gcig bzhugs pa la/ klu'i bu dang bu mo mang pos/ phyag dang mchod pa dang bskor ba byed kyin 'dug go /'ja' tshon sna lnga pa zhig gis gur phub pa/ de la ma cig gis sku rgyab gtad nas bzhugs 'dug pas/ lta ba'i nyams mgur khro lo lo/ dga' dga' dgyes dgyes zhig tu 'dug pas/ de ltar mthong ma thag tu ma la dad pa skyes nas/ gsol ba 'di ltar du btab bo/ /ma gnyan sa ri khrod phyogs med na/ /sems nyam nga med pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /blo phyogs ris med pa'i lta ba can/ /bu lta bas grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /ces dgongs spyod ma'i gsol 'debs de de'i dus su mdzad do/ / yang lan gcig gi dus su/ nub mo nam mkha' gsal ba la/ ma gcig gi zhal nas/ 'og min bltar 'dod dam gsungs/ 'dod lags zhus pas/ nga la 'jus la mig tshums shig byas pas/ skad cig ma la 'og min du slebs nas/

zhing khams kyi bkod pa dpag tu med pa gzigs te/ ma gcig snga dro'i dus su yum chen mor mdzad nas pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos gsungs/ de nas sgrol mar mdzad nas/ thugs rje phyogs ris med pa'i lag len gyi skor mang du gsungs/ dgongs mo rnal 'byor mar sprul nas sngags 'bras bu'i theg chen gyi skor gsungs/ bu la da bkod pa 'di lta bu ma bshad pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang bkod pa khyod min pa la rdzogs par bstan pa med/ gzhan gyi blor mi shongs bas gab par gyis gsungs so/ /de'i dus su gdams pa gnang ba tsho brjed thor bkod pa ni/ ngo mtshar bka' babs kyi skor dang gcig /gnad 'gags dris len gyi skor dang gnyis/ mkha' 'gro'i zhal gyi gdams pa'i skor dang gsum/ brgyud pa ma bu bzhi'i skor dang bzhi/ zab don stong thun lnga brgya'i skor dang lnga la sogs pa mang du bzhugs pa lags so/ /de la sogs pa rdzu 'phrul dang nus pa mchog dang ldan pas/ gsung gi bdud rtsi dpag tu med pa zhig byon pa lags so/ /gces par 'dzin zhing skal ldan gtsug gi rgyan dang*/ don gyi sgron me byed pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod cing*/ kun la phan thog cher 'dug pas/ bsdu ba dang rnam grangs dang*/ phyogs gar gtogs pa'i dbye ba zhig zhu bar dgongs nas/ sras thod pa dang*/ khu sgom la sogs pa bu chen bzhis ma cig la zhus/ gal te ma cig sku gshegs nas gsung pa'i chos 'di rnams gang du bsdu/ thor bu rnams gang du mi la byin/ 'dus pa dga' bar 'dug pas/ grangs mang rtsis su gang la bgyi zhus pas/ ma cig gi zhal nas/ nga'i gdams pa bu slob rnams la song ba re res kyang chog pa yod/ thams cad 'dzoms na'ang legs/ chos ni gang dang yang bstun tu bcug /'on kyang spu ris su phye na/ phyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin pas/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ma shes kyang*/ sdud pa re tsam la bshad pa gyis/ nang gsang sngags dang mthun pa yin pas/

rgyud sde chen po mang po ma shes kyang*/ phag mo'i sgrub thabs re tsam skyongs gsungs/ chos 'di la yangs su bya'am/ dam du bya zhus pas/ ngas ni ya gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen nas/ ma gi mdze sprang yan chod la bshad dgos pa byung*/ de la dbang thob pa ji snyed cig yong bar 'dug pas/ chos la yangs su byas na thams cad mnyam stai/ gsang sngags kyi skad ma bcug par pha rol tu phyin pa'i dgongs pa nas bshad pa yin/ khyed rang rnams kyang pha rol tu phyin pa'i dgongs par byas nas mang du gyis/ yang spyir gsang sngags dang mthun dgos/ sgos bla med dang*/ yang sgos pha rgyud dang ma rgyud gnyis nas spyod pa 'dra bshad pa'i nyams len yin pas sngon la dbang re bskur la/ chos 'chad dus tshogs dang gtor ma bshams la bshad do/ /dbang la 'jug pa'i gang zag gi rim pa dang bstun nas yul dang sbyor ba gal che/ rgyud dang man ngag tsho la ltos dang mthun pa'i lung drangs la bshad do/ /bka' la dam par gyis/ su thod thod la ma bshad/ spyir gcod kyi skor tsho bsdu na man ngag bdud kyi gcod yul/ rigs kyis dbye na/ bka' dang nyams brgyud gnyis/ zhu ba po gang zag gis dbye na/ pho brgyud mo brgyud gnyis/ yongs su grags tshul gyis dbye na/ bka' ma dang gter ma gnyis/ dngos po'i sgo nas dbye na/ gzhung khrigs chags dang kha 'thor khrigs med gnyis yin/ zung bzhi ya brgyad du grags pa'o/ /khrigs chags la bzhi yin/ de la phyi bka' tshoms su zhib rgyas su bstan pa/ nang gdams ngag le lag tu bstan pa/ dgos don zhal gdams gnad thems su bstan pa/ gsang ba brda chos brda ru bstan pa'o/ /'phris gcod kyi gzhung 'phrul chos drug pa/ zhal gdams bcu bzhir bstan pa yin/ da res skabs su babs pa ni/ gcod kyi gdams pa gcig tu bsdus pa gcod mkhan gyi nyams myong lhan cig tu dril ba bla ma thams cad kyi gsung sgros lhan cig tu ston pa/ a ma jo mo'i gcod skor ji snyed cig gsung gi gdams pa 'di la ma 'dus pa med cing ma gyes pa gcig kyang med do/

/ des don gsum gyis bstan te/ spyi khrid bstan pa dang*/ nyams khrid bskyangs ba dang*/ zhal gdams su btab pa'o/ /de la spyi khrid ni rgyab skyor gyi chos yin pas/ gcod thams cad kyi go ba skyed par byed/ nyams khrid kyis lag len du btab nas khrid du bskyangs/ des nyams su len du 'jug pa'o/ /zhal gdams gegs sel bogs 'don rnams kyis gzhan don sgrub pa'o/ /de la zhal gdams sgrub thabs byin rlabs sgo 'byed/ rmi lam nyi zla sgo 'byed/ 'pho ba thar pa'i sgo 'byed/ bar do 'od gsal sgo 'byed/ gegs sel rten 'brel sgo 'byed/ bogs 'don yon tan sgo 'byed/ gzhan don phrin las sgo 'byed/ grub mtha' khyad 'phags sgo 'byed dang bcas so/ /de rnams zhal gdams yin pas/ gcod kyi ngo sprod khrid/ gdams pa rnams tshar ba'i rjes la byin no/ /lhan thabs rnams ni spyi khrid kyi skabs su bstan la bshad do/ /pha rol tu phyin pa'i gcod kyi lo rgyus bstan pa rnams rdzogs so// //

kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer gyis mdzad pa maṅga laṃ/ dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (26)gcod kyi gdams pa thugs kyi snying po'i lo rgyus/ - PAGE 122 -- PAGE 123 -- PAGE 101 -
